Let's explore the history of Big Data, Hadoop, Spark, and Databricks—how it all started, who created these technologies, and why they became essential for modern data processing.
All code and data files are available on the below path:
You’ll learn:
Why Big Data became a challenge (Volume, Variety, Velocity)
Google’s 2004 paper on GFS & MapReduce
How Doug Cutting developed Hadoop and its ecosystem (Hive, Pig, etc.)
The rise of Spark at UC Berkeley AMP Lab (2009) and its Apache adoption (2013)
The foundation of Databricks by the original Spark creators
